name: Frame-Guard
description: Frame-Guard Android overlay with object and player bounds, observed trail, FPS counter, and synced in-game/settings controls.

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Show thin outline bounds for visible level objects and player bounds.

show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Show a short, fading trail of recent player positions.

show-player-bounds.name: Show player bounds
show-player-bounds.description: Show Geometry Dash's object-rect bounds for player 1 and player 2.

show-fps.name: Show FPS counter
show-fps.description: Show a lightweight FPS estimate based on PlayLayer update delta time.
